findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Module/Submodule/LinearMap.lean:210 `def restrict (f : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) {p : Submodule R M} {q : Submodule R₂ M₂} (hf : ∀ x ∈ p, f x ∈ q) : p →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] q`; :216 `coe_restrict_apply ... : ↑(f.restrict hf x) = f x := rfl`; :240 `restrict_comp`; :247 `restrict_smul_one`. mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Module/Submodule/Lattice.lean:415 `AddSubgroup.toIntSubmodule`, :426 `coe_toIntSubmodule ... := rfl`.
findings.fix: Define `integralDividedPower x M n hM := ((Associative.dividedPower n x).restrictScalars ℤ).restrict (p := M.toIntSubmodule) (q := M.toIntSubmodule) hM` (`AddSubgroup.toIntSubmodule`, Mathlib/Algebra/Module/Submodule/Lattice.lean:415, has the same carrier — `coe_toIntSubmodule` is `rfl` — so the result has type `Module.End ℤ M`). Then delete `integralDividedPower_apply` in favour of the `@[simp]` `LinearMap.coe_restrict_apply`, and prove the `zero`/`mul` helpers from `restrict_smul_one` / `restrict_comp` plus `Associative.mul_dividedPower`.
findings.issue: `integralDividedPower` builds the restriction of an invariant linear map to a subgroup from raw `toFun`/`map_add'`/`map_smul'` pieces; Mathlib's `LinearMap.restrict` (Mathlib/Algebra/Module/Submodule/LinearMap.lean:210) does exactly this assembly. Consequently `integralDividedPower_apply` (line 78) restates `LinearMap.coe_restrict_apply` (:216), `integralDividedPower_zero` (line 83) restates `LinearMap.restrict_smul_one` (:247) at `μ = 1`, and `integralDividedPower_mul` (line 91) re-derives what `LinearMap.restrict_comp` (:240) supplies on the operator side.

findings.evidence: Kostant/Exponential.lean:100-102: `exp_zsmul_smul_mem hnil (fun n w hw => by rw [← Associative.map_dividedPower ρ n]; exact hM _ (dividedPower_mem_kostantForm e h i n) w hw) t hv` versus BaseChangeAction.lean:60-61: `rw [← Associative.map_dividedPower ρ n]; exact hM _ (dividedPower_mem_kostantForm e h i n) v hv`.
findings.fix: Move `dividedPower_apply_mem_of_kostantForm_apply_mem` into `Kostant/Exponential.lean` (it needs only `Form.lean` + `Associative.lean`, both already imported there), and rewrite `exp_zsmul_apply_mem_of_kostantForm_apply_mem` as `exp_zsmul_smul_mem hnil (fun n w hw => dividedPower_apply_mem_of_kostantForm_apply_mem e h ρ hM i n hw) t hv`.
findings.issue: `dividedPower_apply_mem_of_kostantForm_apply_mem` is a verbatim copy of the anonymous proof already inlined in `exp_zsmul_apply_mem_of_kostantForm_apply_mem` (Kostant/Exponential.lean:100-102): both are `rw [← Associative.map_dividedPower ρ n]; exact hM _ (dividedPower_mem_kostantForm e h i n) _ _`. After this PR the same fact is proved twice in the repository, and the older copy cannot use the new lemma because the new file imports Exponential.lean.

summary: Two duplications: `integralDividedPower` hand-builds a linear map that `LinearMap.restrict` (plus `restrictScalars`/`toIntSubmodule`) already assembles, and `dividedPower_apply_mem_of_kostantForm_apply_mem` re-proves inline reasoning already present in `Kostant/Exponential.lean`. The core base-change exponential and its group law are genuinely new.
